people.name: Nineveh
people.line: The capital of Assyria, known for its wickedness and repentance

translations.web: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me.”
translations.bsb: “Get up! Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it, because its wickedness has come up before Me.”
